title: Vital Freebase E-Liquid – Flavourless 60ml
description:
Introducing Flavourless by Vital 60, an e-liquid that offers a clean and pure vaping experience without any added flavours. This e-juice is perfect for vapers who prefer a tasteless and odorless vape.
Made with only the highest quality ingredients, Flavourless by Vital 60 offers a smooth and satisfying vape that is free from any added flavours or sweeteners.
The e-liquid comes in a 60ml bottle, which is the perfect size for vaping on the go. The sleek and stylish design of the bottle makes it easy to carry with you wherever you go, so you can enjoy a clean and pure vape experience whenever you want.
Flavourless by Vital 60 is also available in different nicotine strengths, so you can choose the level of nicotine that best suits your needs. This e-liquid is perfect for those who are looking for a nicotine hit without any added flavours or sweetness.
Flavour Notes:
Flavourless
70 VG 30 PG
